description: After a workflow stops, retain source changes but safely remove untracked generated deps, _build, and cover directories from its retained Hancho worktree. Record removed and skipped data.

comments.text: Implemented in 70b8a4c. Failed runs now remove safe untracked _build, deps, and cover data while they keep source changes. Tracked directories are skipped.

title: Prune generated data from failed worktrees
